{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment=0.00) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Apply upward bias correction when sentiment is positive (sentiment>0.00) and model underestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% after a sharp price spike (e.g., >10% from prior day) to avoid overshoot.",
    "Use mean reversion logic: if 3-5 consecutive days show consistent overestimation, gradually reduce forecast by 1-2% per day.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent history (last 7-10 days) when sentiment is positive, to capture momentum.",
    "Apply lag correction: if true outcome is higher than forecast, delay next forecast by 1-2 days to avoid premature peak prediction.",
    "When sentiment is positive and forecast is below true outcome, increase forecast by 2-5% to align with bullish momentum.",
    "If model consistently underestimates prices in the last 10 days, apply a 3-5% upward bias to correct for persistent underperformance."
  ]
}
